subject: patchwork autumn hills
pose: hills sweeping in broad low curves
art_direction: 秋山被分成赭红、鼠尾草绿和奶金大色面，坡线在底部舒展。
visible_description: 秋山被分成赭红、鼠尾草绿和奶金大色面，坡线在底部舒展。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Compose autumn hills as broad interlocking fields of rust, sage and pale gold, with the strongest curves concentrated at the bottom. Keep the collage flat, adding only slight paper grain within each color area. One tiny dark tree cluster anchors a lower ridge. The upper field remains pale and tranquil, emphasizing graceful shape relationships rather than scenic detail. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
